correctness.rationale: Strict convexity/concavity and injective Laplacian weighting prove unrestricted uniqueness; full matching-preserving automorphisms yield the two orbits. value.rationale: Two standard and independently motivated network objectives produce genuinely different optimal support on a nonempty explicit surcharge interval for every network size. This resolves exact pruning policy and size scaling, not just a generic KKT condition or finite numerical table. The difference persists with all edge conductances optimized independently, and is pertinent to spanning-tree-versus-commute-time allocation choices.
